about.title: About Cooper CPA Group
text: Gary Cooper has been recognized by ABC News- Channel 13 as “Your Rock Star CPA.” With that said, if you are looking for a blend of personal service and expertise, you have come to the right place! Our team offers a broad range of solutions for business owners, executives, and independent professionals.

Our core values are based on an energetic, lively, and friendly environment. At Cooper CPA Group, we have implemented a flat organizational chart, which comes from trust in our very competent staff. We believe in relationships which can only be built through strong communications.

Our staff have regular team building activities to enhance the internal health of our organization. This leads to strong collaboration when assisting our customers. Collaboration is the key-working together with a smile.
